tracks.title: Kosi Bharal (कोसी भरल)
tracks.lyric: Kosi bharal Chhathi Maiya, geet gaila...
tracks.meaning: The kosi (earthen altar) is filled — invocation to Chhathi Maiya on Kharna night.

tracks.title: Uga Ho Suraj Dev (उगा हो सूरज देव)
tracks.lyric: Uga ho Suraj Dev, arghya lebo...
tracks.meaning: Rise, O Sun God — awaiting Usha Arghya at dawn.

tracks.title: Jai Chhathi Maiya (जय छठी मैया)
tracks.lyric: Jai Jai Chhathi Maiya, sabke bhagya jagaila...
tracks.meaning: Praise to Chhathi Maiya, protector of children and family.

tracks.title: Kellwa Ke Paat Par (केलवा के पात पर)
tracks.lyric: Kellwa ke paat par, uge Suraj Mal...
tracks.meaning: Offerings laid on banana leaves — the classic Sandhya Arghya song.

tracks.title: Pahile Pahil Chhathi Maiya (पहिले पहिल छठी मैया)
tracks.lyric: Pahile pahil Chhathi Maiya ke, sat sat pranam...
tracks.meaning: First salutations to Chhathi Maiya — sung while filling the daura.

tracks.title: Suraj Sange Chhathi (सूरज संगे छठी)
tracks.lyric: Suraj sange Chhathi Maiya, deep jalaila...
tracks.meaning: With the Sun, we worship Chhathi — evening vigil song.
